figures.caption_stub: System overview. Four sources feed one corpus: ground-truth paraphrases, the architecture catalog, frontier-model answers and frontier-authored plants (reached through Kaggle's model access, not self-hosted). Every candidate must pass the physics tool suite (first law, second law, component limits); accepted rows go to the corpus, rejected attempts go to the failure memory, which feeds back into the prompts. Harness text is added to 35 % of the rows, and SFT and GRPO run data-parallel on two T4 GPUs. The teacher paths are designed and their results are pending; no model has been trained.
figures.alt_text: Four cards: sources (four coloured source rows, two dashed for the pending teacher paths), the CPU environment with a plant graph, the three tool-suite checks and accept, reject, reward and feedback pills, and the policy loop with coloured prompt tokens, the model and a retry box. Below them a corpus box and a failure-memory box, and a blue training card with two GPU chips, reward diagnostics, SFT, GRPO and adapters. Numbered arrows trace the path.

figures.caption_stub: Training pipeline. Tagged sources are combined (harness text on a nominal 35 % of base rows, failure notes added, prompts above 11500 characters or 8000 tokens dropped and counted; verifier-accepted frontier tool-using CoT traces are kept as SFT completions), then SFT on two DDP ranks in fp16 with LoRA r 16, merge, and GRPO per task with G = 4 and 16 prompts per step (k = 4, 8 and 16 checkpoints saved to distinct paths); reward diagnostics run on the CPU first, and evaluation scores frontier zero-shot, frontier+harness+tools+skills+memory, other thermo LLMs, our SFT and our SFT+GRPO on the held-out set. Lower panel: rows per split of the ground-truth datasets and the architecture corpus; the corpus has 123,024 rows (109,659 training) and trained-model evaluation results are pending.
figures.alt_text: Six numbered panels: tagged sources, the combine step with a harness-share bar, note tokens and a prompt-length limit, SFT with token strip and two GPU chips, a reward-diagnostics line chart, a GRPO rollout illustration with reward and advantage bars, and an evaluation panel with a dashed trained-model pill; below, stacked split bars for five datasets.
